correctness.rationale: On trace-free quadratics the intrinsic Hessian is twice the tangent restriction of P_x A P_x minus f_A P_x. Its squared norm divided by four is ||A||_F^2−2||Ax||^2+(d+2)|f_A|^2. Full sphere moments give global Hessian energy 4||A||_F^2. The three symmetry types exhaust the space and remain orthogonal for the regional form, including in d=3 and after complexification. Conditioning on u=x_d^2 gives the beta density in the proof; each difference of the three conditional energy polynomials integrates to its stated linear-factor boundary expression. Their simple zeros are in the stated order. The ranks sum as claimed at ties, analyticity excludes eigenvalues zero and one at interior cutoffs, and the maximum/minimum ratio is the squared observation condition number. An independent symbolic check of the gap identities and a d=3 tangent-frame Gram calculation corroborate the proof.
residual_risks: Pure degree two and full continuous intrinsic Hessian only; the finite d=3 check does not prove the all-dimensional statement.

On the same quadrupoles, ||Hess f||²/4=||A||_F²+d|f|²−|grad f|²/2. Normalizing the integrals gives H_J=area(E_t)+2(S_J−G_J)/(d+2) for every sector J. Inserting the published branch differences gives all three frozen gaps, zeros and crossing multiplicities without a new cap spectral calculation. The gradient comparison is dated the same day; this is established mathematical overlap and failure to establish a distinct claim, not a determination of publication order or attribution.
